items.t: I can define primary socialisation and say who is mainly responsible for it.
I can name Parsons’ three stages of socialisation and say which one comes first.
I can give an example of primary socialisation, such as a parent teaching a child to say please.
I can define secondary socialisation and say how it differs from primary socialisation.
I can name agents of secondary socialisation, such as education, peers, the media and religious organisations.
I can say what Parsons meant by tertiary socialisation and give an example.
I can define formal socialisation using the idea of rules being deliberately and consciously taught.
I can give an example of formal socialisation and of a formal sanction, such as a school detention.
I can explain a criticism of Parsons: people may know the rules but choose not to follow them.
I can define informal socialisation and explain how it differs from formal socialisation.
I can give an example of informal socialisation, such as picking up canteen culture at work.
I can use Giddens’ definition of socialisation in an answer.
